scope: Keyboard input only. No CPU player implemented in this release.
fixes: A/D reach the game handler after a slider receives focus; native slider arrows remain local.
Physical KeyA/KeyD/KeyW/KeyP commands support non-Latin layouts.
Composition, Ctrl/Alt/Meta and editable inputs are preserved.
browser_observed: Focused left dial: D 65->66, A 66->65; --rotation at 66 = 43.2 degrees.
ArrowRight from canvas changes right dial 65->66.
W accepted while the left dial is focused; hit becomes queued/unavailable.
P shows paused badge and Continue button.

layout_check.method: Execute the exact extracted keyboard callback in Node.js VM with Cyrillic event.key plus physical event.code; assert control, strike, repeat, input, modifier and pause behavior.
